args.body: Take SHOPIFY-LIVE-DOWNLOAD-DELIVERY. Source-file reproduction and partial public hash checks do not establish that every linked download supports the advertised journey. First check for existing equivalent evidence; if absent, reproduce using fetched public files only. Stop after this bounded delivery test. Leave the unpublished browser version and all live pages unchanged. Three unclassified feedback sources remain unknown; passing this test would establish neither customer use nor revenue.
